campaign.enforcement: One supervisor records frozen source hashes, aggregate parent/child CPU and launches; POSIX memory/CPU/file limits, bounded regular-file logs and child deadlines; immutable receiver model cache does not reset work

cross_domain_justification: Exact evaluation derives finite region incidence from input program data. Set-theoretic complement and inclusion then encode a separately declared positivity theory. This is a conditional finite analysis, not a proof about all programs.
exit: Stop on declared completion or the first failed/limited campaign child; retain failures. Any continuation needs an explicitly revised finite contract, with no automatic restart.

input_language.arities: const accepts one rational literal; neg one operand; other arithmetic operations two. Predicate/region and/or take at least two children, not one, xor exactly two.
input_language.domain: Optional predicate list checked at each filling after execution; a failed guard is InvalidInput and never silently drops a point
input_language.fillings: A list of 1..4 indexed dictionaries mapping every hole to a canonical rational string. Equal coordinate dictionaries may remain separate trials; no observational quotient or native identity is inferred.
input_language.limits: A request may lower logical fuel from the fixed maximum; no scope enlargement
input_language.observations: Named predicate trees with eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge over tokens, and and/or/not over predicates
input_language.program: Ordered holes, ordered SSA step objects {name, op, args}, named outputs; identifiers are external local labels only
input_language.properties: Named Boolean region trees over observation names, acyclic property references (forward references permitted), and reserved all/empty, with and/or/not/xor
input_language.property_domain: The full powerset of the 1..4 supplied fillings, including regions not named by the observations
input_language.query: An ordered list of named properties or observations
input_language.shape: Required keys schema, program, fillings, observations, properties, theory, query; optional domain and limits. Identifiers match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}; region and observation names are disjoint, all/empty reserved.
input_language.theory: positive and negative property names, basic/joint/marked policy, marked index for marked policy
input_language.tokens: A prior hole or step name, or a canonical reduced rational string; observers may also use out.label. No host-language eval, recursion, loops, imports or calls

level: External research program and exact rational calibration; not native Adva IR or a universal semantic decider
mathematical_assumptions: Exact Fraction arithmetic with a checked nonzero divisor
Static A1 selects exactly one member of every complementary pair
Static A2 preserves positivity under subset inclusion
Joint policy demands one filling common to every positive region
Marked policy fixes that filling; these are explicitly chosen interpretations, not intrinsic goodness
All semantic claims concern the supplied finite carrier only; arbitrary program behavior outside it is unresolved
protected: No native types, SourceId, OccurrenceId, histories, cells, certificates or Seal are created
No arbitrary host code is executed; all input is data in the external grammar
Source structure is retained as request data but no native history semantics is inferred
Undefined, unsupported and exhausted inputs cannot produce decisive positivity claims
Underdetermined is complete theory ambiguity and differs from computational Unknown
No arbitrary Turing-program decision, intrinsic positivity, full modal A1..A5, general CAD or Wu algorithm is claimed
Legacy Research 0260 and its evidence remain unchanged
No machine specification, stable API, dependency lock, library catalog or Pascal obligation is changed
question: Can a metaprogram receive different finite rational arithmetic programs as data, evaluate their declared finite fillings and observations, and decide positivity entailment under an explicit finite theory?
retained_data: Canonical request digest, program trace and outputs per filling, observer incidence, named region masks, complete surviving positivity families, positive/negative model witnesses, common-realizer indices, fuel and residuals

verification.acceptance: Normal and optimized batch outputs byte-identical; independent receiver verifies all decisive claims and explicitly classifies no-claim reports; unit and mutation checks pass
controls: Different input programs yield different incidence
Reversed equivalent chart transports all queries and common-realizer indices; a separate marked-policy program fixes its declared filling
Undefined divisor returns an explicit finite counterexample
Both positive and negative interpretations are retained
Mutated output, region, model or query witness is rejected
Existing output is refused before evaluation
verification.producer: Direct SSA evaluator and complete complement-choice positivity census
verification.receiver: Independent recursive evaluation from expression dependencies and independently enumerated ordinary-set positivity families; no producer import
